name: Wafer the Silver Cat
blurb: Wafer, a sleek silver-white cat whose coat throws a faint rainbow shimmer in the sun, sits still as glass on the round stone by the pond.

name: Stacker the Charcoal Cat
blurb: Stacker, a charcoal-grey cat with gold eyes, naps atop a tower of stacked boxes in the sanctuary shed and knows which one hides his mouse.

name: Recall the Grid Tabby
blurb: Recall, a grey mackerel tabby with ruler-straight stripes and green eyes, remembers where every garden treat is tucked and every kind face.
